description: Run Google's real PageSpeed Insights (Lighthouse + Chrome UX Report) against a URL: performance score, Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP/TBT), and real-user field data where available. The authoritative, Google-measured score — for a quick raw TTFB/size timing check from this server use page_performance_check instead. Works without an API key at low volume; set GOOGLE_PAGESPEED_API_KEY server-side for higher throughput.
name: pagespeed_insights
